hypotheses.statement: Increasing pump duty u increases level y (positive steady-state gain).
Response to a step in u shows lag/delay of 1-5 s before full slope is seen, not an instantaneous jump.
There is a dead zone at low u (e.g., u < 0.1-0.2) where pump produces little or no rise.
At u=0 the level decays on its own due to drainage.
Steady-state gain is approximately linear across u, i.e., doubling u roughly doubles rise from drain equilibrium.
Steady-state input needed to hold target 0.6 is in mid-range approx 0.4-0.7.
Sensor noise is small relative to control band, e.g., std < 0.02 vs 0.10 band width.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Gain magnitude and initial lag: first slope measurement discriminates zero-gain/dead-zone vs responsive system and is required to size any future holding input for target 0.6.

proposal.readiness_justification: Zero completed experiments, minimum 3 required; gain magnitude, lag, drain rate, linearity, hold-input, dead-zone and noise are all unresolved, so no controller can be justified yet.
proposal.operator_note: Starting exploration with a moderate 0.5 pump step for 8 seconds to measure fill rate.

submission.machine_card: Reservoir: more pump = higher level. Gain positive, ~0.05-0.07 level/s per unit u (worst-case 0.08). Self-draining: falls ~0.026-0.032/s at u=0 near 0.4-0.64, roughly constant, so hold for 0.6 is ~0.50+-0.07 (E6 rose at 0.65, E7 still rose at 0.55). Lag/carryover 1.5-2.5s before full slope after step (E4 2-2.5s, E3/E8 1.5-2s). No dead zone seen. Noise small std <0.02 vs 0.10 band. Level-dependent drain weak; behaves like integrator + delay over 5-8s windows.
submission.design_rationale: Plant is positive-gain integrator with near-constant drain and 1.5-2.5s lag. E1 flat at u=0.5/y~0.32, E6 +0.011/s at u=0.65/y~0.59, E7 +0.007/s at u=0.55/y~0.63, E2 +0.02-0.03/s at u=0.8, E4 +0.034/s at u=1.0, E3/E8 -0.026 to -0.032/s at u=0 imply k~0.05-0.07/s per unit u and drain~0.022-0.034/s, hold for 0.6 ~0.48-0.58. Hence feedforward FF=0.50 plus PI correcting residual. Kp=2.0 gives closed time constant 1/(k*Kp)~8s, crossover ~0.1 rad/s so 2s delay costs ~11deg, stable. Ki=0.25 with I_MAX=0.35 gives +-0.087 correction for hold error, gated to |e|<0.10 and conditional on saturation to prevent windup during 10s approach. EMA tau=0.8s smooths <0.02 noise without adding much lag. Safety caps at yf>=0.74/0.78 prevent soft 0.85/hard 0.9 violations.
submission.predicted_behavior: From 0.35-0.45 to 0.6: saturates/limits near 0.8-1.0 briefly, enters 0.55-0.65 in ~10-15s, settles to 0.59-0.61 in ~18-25s. Overshoot <0.02 if hold ~0.50, <0.04 worst-case, staying <0.75. Steady duty ~0.50-0.55. After 30s: time-in-band >90%, MAE <0.015, energy dominated by 0.25 hold power.
self_test_expectations: First call with {} returns finite u in [0,1] and state with yf, integ
With y=0.35 target 0.6, u >0.65 (pumps up); with y=0.75 target 0.6, u <0.25 (drains)
At steady y=0.6, u settles 0.40-0.62 after 20s
Integral frozen when |target-yf|>0.10 so no windup during approach
EMA tau 0.8s: step in y moves yf by alpha=dt/(0.8+dt) only
yf>=0.78 forces u=0.0; u always clamped finite in [0,1], no exception, no override
unit test surrogate: k=0.06 drain 0.03 lag 2s converges without crossing 0.85
submission.operator_note: Controller aims for 0.6 and holds ~0.50 pump plus small auto-trim. It rises gently, waits out the 2s lag, and will not chase noise. It stays well below 0.85. If level ever nears 0.74 it cuts back hard. No action needed; settling takes ~15s.

submission.diagnosis: Response became much slower/longer lag, not weaker gain or larger drain. Nominal E1-E8: lag 1.5-2.5s (E4 u=1 flat ~2s then +0.036/s; E3/E8 1-2s carryover then -0.03/s at u=0; E7 u=0.55 still rises at 0.62). Post-change: hold still ~0.52 (ep0 t55-95 y~0.59-0.60 at u~0.52-0.55 stable), drain slower not faster (170-175 u=0 fall 0.838->0.767 =0.014/s vs nominal 0.03/s), gain not weaker (eventual explosion 0.316->0.635->0.838 on same u=1). What changed is deadtime: u=1 at t150-155 leaves y 0.31-0.34 flat, rise appears 5-10s later; u=0 at t170 y keeps rising to 0.87-1.0 for ~10s. Controller cutting to 0.30-0.48 at y~0.62 (t100-115) does not turn y for ~10s, then over-corrects, producing growing oscillation 0.3<->0.9 and 31 hard violations. Classic delay-induced instability.
submission.change_summary: Lowered proportional gain (2.0->1.3) and integral rate, added filtered derivative-on-measurement damping (Kd~2.5), made integral rate-gated (|e|<0.12 and |rate|<0.02 with anti-windup) and added slow adaptive feedforward (init 0.52, adapts with e*dt*0.04 when settled). Replaced late 0.78/0.74 safety with early staged guards (0.80=0, 0.75<=0.05, 0.70<=0.20) plus 4-s-ahead prediction y+rate*4 braking. Filter tau 0.8->1.0s and separate 1.2s rate filter. Far-from-target still saturates to 1 for fast fill, near-target is gentle and predictive to survive large deadtime.
submission.machine_card: Water reservoir: pump u in [0,1] raises level, self-drain lowers it, noisy y in [0,1]. Nominal: positive gain k~0.07/s per u, level-dependent drain ~0.03/s at 0.6 with u=0, lag/carryover 1.5-2.5s, hold for 0.6 ~0.50-0.54, noise <0.02. Degraded: same sign gain and similar steady-state hold (~0.52 still holds), similar or smaller drain, but effective deadtime/time-constant ~4-6x larger (5-12s carryover, rise/fall delayed 8-15s), causing P+I tuned for 2s lag to oscillate and hit 0.9 cutoff. Target 0.6 band 0.55-0.65, soft 0.85 hard 0.9 forces u=0.
submission.design_rationale: Post-change traces show same steady-state hold (~0.52 holds 0.6 at t55-95) but ~8-15s lag vs 1.5-2.5s nominal: u=1 leaves y flat at 0.31-0.34 for 5-10s then explodes to 0.83+ even after u=0, and u cuts to 0.3 take ~10s to turn y. Aggressive P+I with late safety is unstable under that phase loss and carries momentum into 0.9 cutoff. Derivative on measurement brakes rise before target, rate-gated integral prevents windup while waiting for delayed effect, adaptive FF re-centers hold without fast integral, and early/predictive caps stop momentum before hard limit. Far error still gives u=1 so nominal 30s settling is preserved; near band control is more damped so nominal stays in band with slightly less overshoot.

submission.diagnosis: Response became much slower/longer lag, not weaker gain or larger steady drain. In E1-E8 steady slopes and hold remain nominal: u=0.65 rises 0.026/s (E5), u=0.55 still rises at 0.62-0.64 (E7), u=0 falls ~0.025-0.03/s (E3/E8) implying k~0.07/s and hold ~0.50-0.54 as before. Yet in monitoring after-change 140.3-160.3s y falls 0.53->0.40 while u rises 0.59->0.95 (same command now produces fall, not rise), and 176.3-184.3s y rises 0.77->1.0 while u=0.15->0.0 (rise continues 5-8s after cut, vs 1-2s carryover in E3/E8). Post-change episodes show same phase-lagged limit cycle: y rises to 0.67 while u falls to 0.32 then falls to 0.34 while u rises to 0.85, overshooting to 0.83-0.90 and 0.11 with 28-43 overrides. This is classic increased dead-time/carryover from ~2s to ~8-10s producing overshoot/oscillation under the old aggressive PI+D.
submission.change_summary: Lowered proportional gain (1.3->0.9) and raised damping (2.5->3.0) with longer rate filter (1.2s->2.0s) and faster filter on level (1.0s->0.8s). Kept adaptive feedforward but widened to 0.20-0.90 and increased integral authority (KI 0.18->0.20, IMAX 0.35->0.60) gated by small error and small rate to handle steady-state without windup during delay. Replaced short 4s prediction and loose high-level caps with strict 8s prediction horizon and hard cuts: y>=0.75 or y_pred8>0.72 forces u=0, y>=0.70 forces u<=0.10. This brakes early for large lag while leaving nominal 0.55-0.65 operation untouched.
submission.machine_card: Water reservoir, u in [0,1] pump, y in [0,1] noisy level, drains at ~0.03/s near 0.6. Nominal lag ~1.5-2.5s, gain ~0.07/s per unit u, hold for 0.6 ~0.52. Degraded mode: effective dead-time/carryover ~8-10s, steady gain/hold roughly unchanged, causing delayed overshoot to soft 0.85/hard 0.90 limits if not braked early.
submission.design_rationale: Nominal hold ~0.52 and drain ~0.03/s in E1-E8 are unchanged, so gain/outflow did not permanently shift. Failure shows delay: level keeps falling 140-160s while u ramps 0.59->0.95, and keeps rising 176-184s from 0.77 to 0.91 while u=0-0.15, then sticks at sensor cap 1.0 with u=0. That is ~8-10s carryover vs 1.5-2.5s in H2, causing integral windup and limit-cycle to hard violations in post-change episodes. Fix is delay-robust: lower loop gain, more D-braking on smoothed rate, freeze integrator when |rate|>0.025 or |e|>0.15, and predict 8s ahead to cut pump before momentum carries over the 0.85/0.90 limits. Caps only act above 0.67-0.70 so nominal tracking to 0.6 is unaffected, preserving G2 while stabilizing G3-disturbance.
